screens.headline: Set up your display for SDR
instructions: Turn off HDR and auto colour management in Windows display settings.
Set the display to its recommended resolution. Dim the room and sit where you normally watch.
Use a neutral picture mode and turn off dynamic contrast, motion smoothing, and edge enhancement.
EyeCal checks display settings by eye. A meter is needed to measure colour accuracy.
screens.should_see: You should see a neutral picture whose brightness stays steady.
screens.bad_example: A bad starting point: the picture changes brightness or colour on its own.
